observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor hall with wooden flooring and a chandelier, audience seated around the dance floor watching a performance
observation.dancers: one man and one woman, as a couple
observation.formation_and_space: couple dancing in close embrace, traveling counterclockwise around the floor
observation.posture: upright torso, knees slightly soft, weight centered over feet
observation.footwork: sliding steps, side steps, crosses, and weight changes closely tied to the slow tango beat; exact stepping intricacy obscured by long skirts and low resolution
observation.arms_and_hands: closed tango embrace with one hand held in open palm connection and the other arm wrapped around the partner's back
observation.hips_and_torso: minimal isolated movements, the torso moves as a solid unit with the partner
observation.partnering: closed embrace, continuous physical contact, clear lead and follow dynamics
observation.levels_jumps_turns: no jumps or floor work; circular turns and pivots executed at standing height
observation.costume_and_props: man wears a dark jacket, button-up shirt, tie, and patterned trousers; woman wears a strapless midi-length bronze-colored dress and high-heeled sandals
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement and rapid weight transfers cannot be verified due to camera distance and clothing occlusion

signature_moments.what: a slow pivot turn in embrace with the woman extending her leg outward
a quick decorative leg flick (gancho) by the woman around the man's leg
rapid sequential leg hooks and extensions (ganchos) performed in tight embrace
